# runwAI

> A template repository that wires deterministic security and compliance checks into a
> project, plus a curated set of AI-native helper files. Its core invariant: AI may perform
> the setup work, but every control must be an ordinary pinned program returning an exit
> code — a model may advise, never adjudicate.

runwAI is Apache-2.0. Vendored third-party content keeps its upstream licence, recorded
per file in `.runwai/docs/provenance.md`.

Two trees are easy to confuse. `AGENTS.md` and `agents/` are live and describe *this*
repository, and an adopting project keeps them. `.runwai/` is the template's own
development record and is deliberately absent from this index: it is not part of an
adopting project. Nothing in this repository is a starter file waiting to be copied
somewhere — every file ships in the place its tool already looks for it.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Entry point for the adopter's agent — the invariant, the obligations, the first session
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): A one-line `@AGENTS.md` import. Claude Code reads this filename and not AGENTS.md, so the bridge is what makes the guide reach it. Holds no content of its own
- [README.md](README.md): The adopter's front door — what runwAI checks, what it does not, and the one step to start
- [Makefile](Makefile): The first session's mechanical steps as pinned, deterministic targets
- [agents/README.md](agents/README.md): Index of rules, commands, skills and knowledge

## Reuse

- [STEAL.md](STEAL.md): The fast path for taking code from this repository — the four steps, and which paths are not Apache-2.0
- [.steal/manifest.md](.steal/manifest.md): The index of stealable resources, with tags and descriptions
- [.steal/curation.md](.steal/curation.md): The curation protocol — how a file is blessed, banned, and kept indexed

## The ISM, machine-readable

- [docs/security-report.md](docs/security-report.md): Where this repository stands against the ISM right now — what is checked, what is not, and what the scanners found
- [docs/dependencies.md](docs/dependencies.md): The software bill of materials — every third-party package, its version and its declared licence. Generated by `make audit`; timestamp-free, so a diff means the dependency set changed
- [controls/ism-index.json](controls/ism-index.json): All 1101 controls, each with semantic tags and a code/infrastructure/organisational surface. Generated — start here to ask what the ISM says about a topic
- [controls/ism-tags.yaml](controls/ism-tags.yaml): The tag vocabulary and the per-section judgements the index is built from

## Architecture

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): The invariant, determinism defined precisely, provenance and licensing rules
- [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md): How this project is set up, as built — what runs, what was removed, what it cannot tell you

## Vendoring and provenance

- [agents/skills/vendor-upstream-content/SKILL.md](agents/skills/vendor-upstream-content/SKILL.md): How to vendor content correctly
- [agents/skills/vendor-upstream-content/references/licence-families.md](agents/skills/vendor-upstream-content/references/licence-families.md): What each licence permits; which to refuse

## Rules

- [agents/rules/_sections.md](agents/rules/_sections.md): Section registry and impact levels
- [agents/rules/_template.md](agents/rules/_template.md): Template for a new rule
- [agents/rules/controls-never-adjudicate-with-llm.md](agents/rules/controls-never-adjudicate-with-llm.md): The core invariant
- [agents/rules/provenance-record-upstream.md](agents/rules/provenance-record-upstream.md): SHA and licence for vendored content
- [agents/rules/provenance-pin-exactly.md](agents/rules/provenance-pin-exactly.md): Exact versions, or none at all
- [agents/rules/quality-claims-need-receipts.md](agents/rules/quality-claims-need-receipts.md): Never assert what you have not checked
- [agents/rules/ci-never-weaken-a-gate.md](agents/rules/ci-never-weaken-a-gate.md): Fix the finding, not the check
- [agents/rules/reference-file-locations.md](agents/rules/reference-file-locations.md): Where everything lives

## Toolchain configs for what you build

- [biome.json](biome.json): Formatting and linting for JavaScript and TypeScript, written against Biome 2.5.5
- [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts): E2E config shaped for streaming responses, written against Playwright 1.62.0
- [promptfooconfig.yaml](promptfooconfig.yaml): Deterministic evals for prompts and agent tools, written against promptfoo 0.121.19

## Optional

- [agents/knowledge/llm-security-guardrails.md](agents/knowledge/llm-security-guardrails.md): Guardrails for LLM-integrated code, keyed to OWASP LLM01–LLM10
- [agents/knowledge/explaining-a-control.md](agents/knowledge/explaining-a-control.md): How an agent explains a control in plain language, grounded in the registry
- [agents/running-the-checks.md](agents/running-the-checks.md): The canonical command list — self-checks, scans, exit codes
- [agents/knowledge-base.md](agents/knowledge-base.md): Vendoring workflow, licence families, network access shape
- [docs/ism-verification.md](docs/ism-verification.md): Control verification method and status
